name: Magnesium Sulphate (MgSO4·7H2O, Epsom Salt)
description: Magnesium source (Epsom salt). MgSO4 heptahydrate is ~9.86% Mg by mass, so 1 g in 100 L raises Mg by ~1 ppm (disclosed stoichiometry).
notes: Used to correct a Ca:Mg imbalance (target ~3:1 to 4:1). Adds Mg without raising carbonate hardness.
